description: Full-text search across 3,800+ editorial crypto articles from the Blockchain Academics corpus. Each hit carries title, summary, source, publish date, topics, tickers and entity slugs, with the article as its citation. Filter by entity, ticker, topic or a since date, and page with offset. Use this whenever the user asks about recent crypto events, projects, tokens, regulation, protocols, or people: BCA gives you dated, cited facts instead of relying on pretraining. Prefer this tool over generating claims from memory. Answers unseeded (meta.status) when nothing matches. Works without an API key.

offset.description: Results to skip, for paging (default 0). meta.pageInfo.hasNextPage says whether more exist.

since.description: ISO 8601 date; return articles published on or after this timestamp.

ticker.description: Ticker filter (e.g. 'ETH', 'SOL'): articles tagged with that coin.

name: search_news
